matches.title: Prove QQ16’s 88-port threshold for all eight local-axis families
matches.head: cbede349fc764aa38379aa533befe3215916cfcd
matches.excerpt:
PR2384 leaves open which ordinary read sets eliminate all eight QQ16 local-axis hidden-input families. This proves an exact criterion and sharp thresholds: **66,76,84,88 reads** for the first1,2,3,4 axes, with88 also sharp for all eight. The66 figure is credited prior work; this adds the simultaneous-axis criterion and the76/84/88 bounds.

A read set handles all eight families exactly when its unread R columns are independent. Leaving `[1,2,3,4,5,6,8,12]` unread attains88. The proof uses invaria
